assets.title: Fixed A-Frame Step Ladder
assets.description: One original low-poly independent A-frame step ladder in one fixed open pose, counted as one prop. Four thick horizontal front treads span two orange sloping front rails. Two dark blue rear support rails with two rear crossbars provide a separate rear support branch, and four flat charcoal foot pads have finite ground patches. A fixed side limiter plate on each side has two finite embedded endpoints. Four genuine bored top ears, two on either side, surround two complete fixed stepped pins. The pin shafts have positive full-surface clearance inside their holes; integral end caps meet the outer ear faces over finite opposed annular regions. The central A-frame volume, spaces between all steps and the rear-frame openings remain genuinely empty. Twenty-two named editable closed meshes and four opaque constant PBR colours, metre scale, native Z up, front -Y, ground-centred footprint origin. One frozen pose only: no people, wall, platform, scaffold, dock, vehicle, scene, texture or animation. The existing playground slide already includes its own platform-supported ladder; this independently created freestanding A-frame is a narrower new structure, with no inherited interface compatibility. Static visual geometry only. No climbing or working height, human fit, folding, locking or motion, assembly path, load capacity, strength, stability, anti-tip behaviour, construction/firefighting/boarding suitability, manufacturing tolerance or safety-code certification. Geometric contact does not establish functional or safe equipment.
